selection: retain all technically valid families and their prespecified final pass; never select using development disparities
source: 2016 NYC RGB first three channels, bilinear resampling to 2017 native reference grid; 512 x 512 at 0.5 ft, gray 127 outside common paired geography
train: positive paired area; first up to 32 per tract by frozen hash
dev: census of valid paired geography; publish zero-area and failed windows

training.loss: cross entropy, positive paired pixels only

cnn: ResNet34 ImageNet IMAGENET1K_V1 and new U-Net decoder; train backbone and decoder
segformer: external B0 ADE checkpoint and new eight-channel classifier; train backbone and decode head; no historical NYC optimizer or model
yolo: YOLO26n-sem native eight-channel semantic head; train main logits; no auxiliary loss
ijepa: frozen H/14 at 224 pixels, 16x16 token grid, supervised 1x1 decoder, resize logits to 512
qwen: zero-shot BF16, mask gray 127, fixed JSON prompt in qwen.py, greedy, no threshold search
rq2_projection: equal-tract observed dev SD, unbalanced one-way random effects block ICC truncated at zero; frozen physical-distance kernel, effective-block t multiplier; supplement inherited SD and ICC scenarios
